Tangram ES 0.10.1: https://github.com/tangrams/tangram-es
Source revision: 3b0463a8bbbb3a3164593a93eeff5465d0b79360
Native libraries independently rebuilt with Android NDK r28c; no source changes.
Upstream Java classes and resources are preserved from the official release AAR.
Original source and dependency license notices accompany the rebuilt AAR under
META-INF/tangram-licenses. Android NDK runtime notices are included there too.

Portions of this software are copyright (c) 2016 The FreeType Project
(www.freetype.org). All rights reserved.

The bundled FreeType 2.7 source omitted its docs directory. FreeType-FTL.txt is
the unmodified FreeType Project License from the corresponding upstream release:
https://github.com/freetype/freetype/blob/d2d5968aed5bc264c885c54d0a50e5355808ab78/docs/FTL.TXT
FreeType is used under that license.
